name: chemical-review
description: Four composable, evidence-governed skills for critical narrative chemical literature reviews.

interface.shortDescription: Iteratively develop a critical chemical literature review.
interface.longDescription: Separates Intent, Research, Synthesis, and multi-angle QA through explicit Markdown handoffs, legal full-text waits, locator-bound evidence, and human scientific acceptance. It does not claim scientific validity or journal acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Use $chemical-review-intent to define and confirm a chemistry review brief.
Use $chemical-review-research to discover sources, route legal full text, and prepare evidence.
Use $chemical-review-synthesis and $chemical-review-qa to draft and independently audit the review.
